subject: Mythology
title: Amaterasu: Goddess of the Sun
description: A fast breakdown of Amaterasu: Goddess of the Sun for builders.

hook.text: When Amaterasu hid in a cave, the entire world went dark and demons roamed freely across the earth.

buildup.text: Her brother Susanoo had rampaged through heaven, destroying rice fields and throwing a dead horse into her weaving hall.

discovery.text: Heartbroken, she sealed herself inside a cave. Without sunlight, crops died and chaos consumed everything.

twist.text: The gods lured her out by placing a mirror outside and having a goddess perform a wild comedic dance.

climax.text: Curious about the laughter, Amaterasu peeked out, saw her own radiance in the mirror, and returned light to the world.

punchline.text: The sun came back because the gods made her laugh.

quiz.question: How did the gods lure Amaterasu out of her cave?
options: They threatened to destroy her sacred shrine
They placed a mirror outside and performed a comedic dance
Susanoo apologized and begged her to return
